title: stage masks: shared
shortDescription: Found Footage: a camcorder's night walk through a birch wood, and one ink vignette that eats the picture and the HUD alike — one mask stage, drawn once, on two slots
description:
A `StageDirector` with the stack `[rot, level, vhs, hud]`. The level is a camcorder's night shot of a birch wood, walked through from the side: rows of trunks at five depths pass at their own speed, symbols are cut into the bark, a tent stands open on the dark — and between the far trees a figure keeps pace, always the same distance away. The HUD is a layer of its own: REC, NIGHTSHOT, a battery on its last bar, the date, the running timecode, the corners of the viewfinder, and SIGNAL LOST whenever the picture goes.

The mask stage `ink` is a `Stage2D` that draws ink over transparent black: a ragged frame worked out per pixel in TSL, pushed in and out by noise, with veins running ahead of it, soft drops that crawl in from the rim, and corners that swell with a heartbeat. **One** `StageMask` reads it, `{invert: true}`, and lies on **two** slots: `director.setMask(level, ink)` and `director.setMask(hud, ink)`. The mask stage is updated and drawn once per frame, and both slots sample the same picture, so the HUD is eaten by exactly the darkness that eats the forest. Between them, the slot `vhs` — tracking band, dropouts, head-switching noise, a chromatic grain — is not masked and runs over the ink untouched; below, the unmasked `rot` is what the ink leaves behind.

*mask on the level* and *mask on the HUD* (keys L and H) set and take off the mask per slot; *mask stage drawn* counts the draws of the ink — one per frame with one masked slot or two, none once no slot holds the mask and its stage has left the director — and *sampled by* counts the slots. *vignette strength* sets how far the ink comes in. See [Stage masks: one mask on two slots](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#one-mask-on-two-slots) and [run and freeze](https://github.com/spearwolf/twopoint5d/blob/main/packages/twopoint5d/docs/stages.md#run-and-freeze).
